name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.
author: Almmatix

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.0.7.

Three languages: choose English, Hinglish, or हिंदी (Devanagari). The whole app now follows your choice, including the Today screen and the phone app.

Payments are more reliable: recording a payment now saves it right away and posts to Tally when the shop PC and Tally are open. A payment that failed can be retried, and your selection no longer disappears while you fill it in.

Always findable: ASVA repairs its Start-menu and Desktop shortcuts every time it opens (and on close), so after an update you can always search "ASVA" and open the real app, never the old setup file.

Free for every shop until 30 September 2026.
